name: 86 Chaos 16.0.83 Admin Employee Delete Permission Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.83 Admin Employee Delete Permission Fix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.83 Admin Employee Delete Permission Fix
notes: Release-gate Firebase Auth verification now sends one canonical Origin header and one canonical Referer header so restricted API-key origin metadata is preserved without duplicate header values.
Role-verification reports now identify duplicate Origin/Referer request formatting as a release-gate test-harness problem instead of telling the user to replace QA accounts.
Schedule Builder time chips keep full unavailable/request-off ranges visible and make actual shift times bolder and easier to read without changing schedule data, publishing, or permissions.

Firestore rules, Storage rules, Firebase config, API keys, Auth domains, project IDs, storage buckets, service account wiring, employee schedule visibility behavior, and session restoration were not changed.
